SELECT r.scoring_rule_version AS ruleVersion, COUNT(*) AS sampleCount FROM interview_report r JOIN interview_session s ON s.id = r.session_id WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND r.status = 'REPORT_READY'
AND r.generated_at >= DATE_SUB(UTC_TIMESTAMP(6), INTERVAL #{days} DAY)
GROUP BY r.scoring_rule_version ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC, MAX(r.generated_at) DESC
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM project_fact f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.confirmation_status = 'CONFIRMED'
